title: 17035 - 17035/P0651/001617
commonCauses: Faulty wiring on Sensör Okuma Değerleri Reference Voltage "B" Circuit
Faulty sensor or component on Sensör Okuma Değerleri Reference Voltage "B" Circuit
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  wiring on Sensör Okuma Değerleri Reference Voltage "B" Circuit
Kontrol edin:  sensors and components on the Sensör Okuma Değerleri Reference Voltage "B" Circuit

Kontrol edin:  wiring at the ECM with all components removed from the Circuit to verify the reference voltage is present.
If the ECM is NOT producing the needed voltage and all powers/grounds going to it are OK, Değiştirin / Yenileyin: ECM.
If the ECM is NOT producing the needed voltage and all powers/grounds going to it are OK, Değiştirin / Yenileyin: ECM.
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: any Golf (1K/5K/AJ) based VW model with a 2nd Gen (2008.5 - 2014 model year) timing chain driven 2.0TSI Gasoline engine, the Sensör Okuma Değerleri Reference Voltage "B" Circuit should be found on terminal T60/29 which powers G40, G247 and G609 (when installed).
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Golf (1K/5K/AJ) based VW models such as a 2013 NMS Passat with CBUA 2.5L Gasoline engine, the Sensör Okuma Değerleri Reference Voltage "B" Circuit should be found on terminal T60/44 labeled "5V2" which powers G40, G271 and G609.
